verdict.rationale: Retell's MCP server documents agent versions: agents can be published and their versions listed and fetched. Conductor proposes edits to prompts, settings, and flows that you review before applying them, which covers versioning and review. missing for 10: any documented rollback or restore-to-previous-version capability, version diffing or history UI docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
